steps.name: Core enforcement engine
steps.description: Hook Router + State Manager + Phase Enforcer + File Classifier + Audit Writer + Phase Transition Manager + Stale Session Detector in single TypeScript plugin file.
criteria: Given a write tool call targeting a production file during RED_ACCEPTANCE phase and an active DES session, when the plugin intercepts tool.execute.before, then the tool call is blocked with a descriptive error message and an audit event is logged to des-audit.jsonl.
Given no deliver-session.json exists in .nwave/des/, when any tool call fires tool.execute.before, then the plugin allows the call without error (fail-open behavior).
Given a session with startedAt older than 24 hours, when any tool.execute.before fires, then an audit event with severity error is logged and the agent receives a suggestion to reset the session.
architectural_constraints: Single file at src/des/opencode-plugin.ts -- zero external dependencies, only fs and path from Bun/Node built-ins
Phase policy encoded as a data structure (policy matrix), not conditional branching
State writes use atomic rename (write to .tmp then fs.renameSync) to prevent corruption
All I/O errors caught and logged -- plugin must never crash OpenCode

steps.name: Custom tools and compaction handler
steps.description: Add des_create_session and des_advance_phase custom tools plus the experimental.session.compacting handler to preserve DES state across context resets.
criteria: Given an orchestrator calls des_create_session with featureId and stepId, when the tool executes, then a new deliver-session.json is created with phase NOT_STARTED, a startedAt timestamp, and an audit event is logged.

Given a session in RED_UNIT phase and the agent calls des_advance_phase with next_phase GREEN and a non-empty evidence string, when the tool executes, then the session phase updates to GREEN, evidence is appended to phaseHistory, and an audit event is logged.

Given OpenCode triggers experimental.session.compacting with an active DES session, when the compaction handler runs, then a des-state block containing featureId, stepId, currentPhase, and filesModified is injected into the compaction context.
architectural_constraints: Custom tools registered through OpenCode's plugin tool registration mechanism
Phase transitions validated against the v4.0 schema transition map (NOT_STARTED->PREPARE->RED_ACCEPTANCE->RED_UNIT->GREEN->COMMIT->COMPLETED)
des_advance_phase rejects transitions not in the valid transition map with a clear error message

steps.name: Python installer plugin
steps.description: InstallationPlugin subclass that copies the TypeScript DES plugin to OpenCode's plugins directory with manifest-based install/verify/uninstall.
criteria: Given src/des/opencode-plugin.ts exists in the source tree, when install() runs, then the file is copied to ~/.config/opencode/plugins/nwave-des.ts and a .nwave-des-manifest.json is written tracking the installed file.
Given a successful installation, when verify() runs, then it confirms nwave-des.ts exists in the plugins directory and contains the string 'tool.execute.before'.
Given .nwave-des-manifest.json exists, when uninstall() runs, then only files listed in the manifest are removed and the manifest itself is deleted.
architectural_constraints: Follows exact pattern of OpenCodeAgentsPlugin: module-level helper functions, manifest-based tracking, try/except with PluginResult
Priority 39 (after opencode-commands at 38, before DES at 50)
Dependencies: ['opencode-commands'] -- requires OpenCode config directory to exist

steps.name: Registry registration and integration test
steps.description: Register OpenCodeDESPlugin in _create_plugin_registry when opencode platform detected. Integration test verifying plugin loads in the registry.
criteria: Given target_platforms contains 'opencode', when _create_plugin_registry executes, then OpenCodeDESPlugin is registered with dependency on opencode-commands and appears in the resolved plugin order after opencode-commands.
Given target_platforms does not contain 'opencode', when _create_plugin_registry executes, then OpenCodeDESPlugin is not registered.

Given the full plugin registry with opencode platform, when topological sort resolves execution order, then opencode-des runs after opencode-commands (priority 39 > 38) and before des (priority 39 < 50).
architectural_constraints: Registration follows existing pattern: instantiate, register, set_dependencies in the opencode conditional block
Import added alongside existing opencode plugin imports at module top
